summary: The 8-K reports Kyntra Bio's receipt of the final $4.0 million holdback from AstraZeneca, completing the sale of its China operations. On August 29, 2025, Kyntra sold its China business via FibroGen International (Hong Kong) Ltd. for total consideration of ~$220 million ($85M enterprise value + ~$135M net cash), with $210M paid at closing. The remaining $10M was held back for adjustments and indemnity; the $6M adjustment holdback was received in November 2025. No indemnity claims were made. The transaction closed and all payments received. Watch for Kyntra's reinvestment of proceeds.
